exposure: Antiphospholipid antibody profile (specifically triple antibody positivity)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 30 pregnant women with primary antiphospholipid syndrome, compared to all pregnancies in Stockholm County during the same period.
finding: Patients with primary antiphospholipid syndrome, especially those with obstetric antiphospholipid syndrome and triple antibody positivity, are at higher risk for adverse pregnancy outcomes, even under antithrombotic treatment.
followup_time: Up to 5 minutes after birth (for Apgar score), with other outcomes assessed at delivery.
